name: fivefold-oof-k8-normal-contour-mlp
amendment: Supersedes review SHA366fb01afb5ce7157da43eede9f559d077820091eeb7afa5016d8e44257921c7 before any code or fit. Independent leakage review found that a gate shot could influence four other crossfit base models and their residual training rows. Reserve the last200 validation shots from every base fit and correction fit. Add a full-frame truth-assisted K8 pilot and a fixed onefold/fivefold-mean transfer gate.
status: Review proposal only: no competition-data target extraction, base fit, correction fit, validation score or reserved-tail read is authorized by this file
question: Can a nonlinear input-only learner trained on genuinely out-of-fold compact-MLP contour residuals recover the boundary improvement that the 35-shot K8 Ridge and full-coordinate absolute MLP did not?

motivation_and_limit.prior_evidence: The fixed 35-shot K8 normal representation retained 0.93915 residual energy but its Ridge predictor did not improve the reused 35-shot evaluation fold. A separate 5633-shot absolute 1024-coordinate MLP produced valid contours but worsened native S on selection-only validation200. The truth-assisted additive/profile operation has positive headroom, but those results do not imply learnability or a public gain.
motivation_and_limit.distinct_test: Use the 5633 original TRAIN shots and first1138 original validation shots (6771 total) for five genuinely held-out base-prediction folds and learn 17 physical normal-displacement coefficients. Reserve the last200 original validation shots as a native gate unseen by every base fit and correction fit. The original salt-0 tail70 remains evaluation-only and is not used for target construction, representation gating, checkpoint choice or feature selection.
motivation_and_limit.interpretation: Any internal gate is selection evidence only. One later original-tail test, if unlocked, is a reused local fold and cannot establish a top-three public result or confidence interval.

source_and_provenance.auxiliary_target_policy: The earlier 6971-shot union cache includes 200 gate labels and has a different scorer source hash; do not alias or read it for this campaign. Build a new cache over exactly the allowed 6771 shots from the frozen producer, then derive each fold's fit subset by verified whole-shot blocks. Gate200 truth remains unopened until sealed native scoring.
source_and_provenance.freeze_rule: Before any real-data fold fit, commit an executable spec, effective YAML, full 7041-shot manifest identity, ordered lists and hashes for all five train/OOF folds, correction train/checkpoint/gate windows, source snapshot and evaluator. Never edit that frozen snapshot.

fivefold_base_predictions.universe: Start with the pinned complete 7041 DIII-D training-corpus filenames in salt-0 SHA1 order. Exclude the exact original last70 filenames and last200 original compact validation filenames by identity, leaving 6771. Assert the resulting ordered names equal the original compact train5633 followed by first1138 validation filenames. The reserved gate200 and tail70 must have zero overlap with every fold fit or OOF target cache.
fivefold_base_predictions.fold_assignment: For zero-based position i in the allowed 6771-shot salt-0 ordered list, assign fold i modulo 5. Fold0 has 1355 shots and folds1-4 have 1354 each; every allowed shot is OOF exactly once. The pilot is the first100 fold0 filenames that also belong to the original compact TRAIN5633 window, in salt-0 order; resolve their hashes before reading labels. No pilot shot belongs to correction checkpoint validation or either native gate.
fivefold_base_predictions.base_model: Each fold trains only the original compact torch_mlp architecture, features, PCA50, target scaler and static-head configuration on the other four folds (5416 or 5417 shots), using the original MLP seed0. The only intentional recipe changes are explicit fold file lists and fixed_steps training with no validation, max_steps=33000, patience_steps=0 and last weights. This count is the original compact MLP's validation-selected best step; it is not tuned using OOF or gate scores. That historical step was itself selected using the compact validation1338, including these gate200 shots, so a weak global hyperparameter-selection exposure remains and is disclosed. No sequence or second base family is fit.
fivefold_base_predictions.explicit_file_guard: Add a narrowly scoped explicit-files manifest accepted only with fit_mode=fixed_steps and zero validation. Check every selected filename and source-file hash against the complete pinned corpus; require exact complement-of-fold, no duplicate, no original70, zero validation and artifact train_files matching the declared list. Artifact OOF fold filenames must be absent from train_files and val_files. The default training path must remain bit-identical in focused tests.
fivefold_base_predictions.auxiliary_cache: Build scorer-native targets through pimap from exactly the allowed 6771 train/checkpoint shots, not the earlier 6971 cache that contains gate200 labels. Verify producer, scorer masks, dependency lock, ordered shot identity and entire float32/NaN target blocks; compose each fold subset atomically by whole per-shot blocks after exact proof. Do not alias a cache because its filename looks right.
fivefold_base_predictions.prediction: Decode each fold's own PCA and target scaler to physical float32 psi before extracting scorer-native 512-point source contours. Fold-specific coefficient vectors are never mixed. Produce one per-shot OOF prediction for every one of the 6771 allowed shots at the same per-shot 0.2 frame indices used by the correction target cache; retain the source artifact hash and assert filename disjointness. Separately predict every gate200 shot at full frames with all five base models, before unsealing gate labels.

pilot_before_remaining_four_fits.scope: Fit fold0 only, then predict its predeclared first100 original-TRAIN OOF shots at 0.2 frame share. Extract scorer-native source and true LCFS on those paired frames for the representation gate. Also produce full-frame source and truth-assisted fixed K8 normal additive+source-li maps on the same100 complete shots and score the actual maps through the unchanged native scorer. These shots are in correction-gradient TRAIN, never checkpoint/gate/tail. No correction learner is fitted yet.
pilot_before_remaining_four_fits.target: Canonical roll of source contour at max R, preserve orientation, minimum-squared cyclic match of true contour, outward unit normal, physical scalar displacement and fixed real Fourier K=8 (DC plus real/imaginary modes1-8 =17 outputs), exactly as the prior synthetic-tested contour_learnability helper.
pilot_before_remaining_four_fits.pass: Every source/true frame must have finite, in-grid, simple contour and 512 points, with no skip or imputation. Pooled normal-energy retention must be >=0.80 and median per-frame RMS residual <= one minimum physical grid spacing on thinned paired frames. The full-frame truth-assisted K8 additive+source-li native S must exceed the unchanged fold0 source by at least +0.002600, with exact submitted scalars and zero native LCFS/derived failures. This is an investment margin: a learner capturing half the pilot oracle improvement would only meet the later +0.001300 gate. It is not a mathematical upper bound on another fold. Failure stops the branch before folds1-4 and the correction learner.

correction_learner_if_pilot_passes.features: Exactly the existing permitted-input 208-column baseline feature vector, seven input-only OOF source-contour summaries Rmin/Rmax/Zmin/Zmax/area/perimeter/centroidR and one shot-phase coordinate, width216. No EFIT target or base-model training-set residual is an inference feature. Construct validation and gate rows with poisoned/absent target columns in tests.
correction_learner_if_pilot_passes.target: Exactly 17 K8 normal displacement coefficients from each shot's OOF source contour and training-only true LCFS, at the paired 0.2-frame indices. Record OOF artifact, frame and target hashes per shot. No target is extracted from original70.
correction_learner_if_pilot_passes.model: One MLP 216->256->256->17 with GELU, seed0, train-only weighted StandardScaler and per-output target standardization (zero-variance output is an error), AdamW lr=0.0003 weight_decay=0.0001, batch4096, max4000 optimizer steps, validation every250, patience1000, keep best validation checkpoint. Sample shots uniformly then frames uniformly within each shot; validation loss is the equal-shot mean coefficient MSE. CUDA is required. All these values must be copied unchanged to the effective YAML before a fit; no sweep or retry under this spec.
correction_learner_if_pilot_passes.learner_windows: Correction gradient training uses the original compact train5633 shots only. From the original validation1338 list, the first1138 shots are correction-checkpoint validation and the last200 shots are the fixed native gate. Entire shots stay together; the gate200 true LCFS is not used for fitting, normalization, checkpoint or feature selection.
correction_learner_if_pilot_passes.map_and_scalars: Predict K8 coefficients from target-stripped inputs, reconstruct physical normal displacement on each source contour, and apply the previously frozen lambda1 contour-local additive psi correction plus nine-a input-only source-li compensation without changing q95/betaN bits. A zero-coefficient control must return exact source psi bits. Count every invalid predicted polygon, additive map and nonzero profile candidate by reason; finite corrected maps may receive native scorer failure penalties rather than being silently omitted.

native_gate_and_possible_tail.internal_gate: All five base artifacts predict the fixed last200 validation shots at full frames, although every such shot was excluded from every base fit. Score two fixed source paths on the identical200 filenames: fold0 MLP alone and equal decoded-map fivefold MLP mean; for EACH path seal original source, learned additive map, and additive+source-li predictions, then score all six through the same pinned untouched native local_score. Report S, psi, q95/betaN, raw D_LCFS, Consistency, all seven functional R2, failure fractions, fallback counts and walls. Pass only if final-minus-source S >=+0.001300 on BOTH paths, gain(mean)/gain(fold0)>=0.50, each path preserves its own submitted scalar bytes, fallback <=1% and zero native failures. Otherwise stop without opening original tail70. Do not choose the better path post hoc.
native_gate_and_possible_tail.tail_if_internal_gate_passes: Evaluate exactly once on the original reserved70 using the original compact MLP as source, first corrected MLP alone and then decoded 50/50 corrected-MLP+unchanged original sequence against a matched decoded compact control. Only if that fixed transfer is positive and material, test a separately preregistered application to the recovered best11 source; its different residual distribution may invalidate transfer. Never use tail70 to train, choose a coefficient basis, alter weights or retune the learner.
native_gate_and_possible_tail.uncertainty: Gate200 shots are excluded from every base fit and correction gradient/checkpoint. The fold0 and fivefold-mean base distributions differ, and the tail uses a different original compact base; transfer uncertainty is explicit. The fixed33000 step count was selected historically using this validation corpus, and other project experiments have used it. This is still an investment screen, not independent top-three confirmation.

resource_estimate_not_measurement.base_fits: One pilot MLP fit likely 4-8 minutes warm; all five likely 20-45 minutes GPU lane plus cache composition and OOF inference. Reference: compact MLP fitted 51,400 steps in151.1 seconds once its data were prepared, and geometry MLP child workers consumed roughly 6-9 minutes including preparation/scoring. Measure actual stages and cgroup/pids before launch.
resource_estimate_not_measurement.correction_targets: Roughly 300000 total 0.2-share paired frames across 6771 allowed shots; source inference, two scorer-native contour extractions and 17-target caching could take tens of CPU minutes and should run through pimap with bounded memory. The one allowed-universe auxiliary rebuild also costs CPU time. Avoid storing all full 65x65 maps for every training frame when per-shot streamed coefficients suffice.
resource_estimate_not_measurement.correction_fit_and_gate: The 17-output correction fit should be shorter than a full baseline fit, but is unmeasured. One fixed200-shot full-frame correction/profile build and three native scorer passes previously took about 23.6 and 7.3 minutes respectively; this six-pass, two-source gate roughly doubles that stage. The full-frame pilot100 adds another native-score and profile pass. Allow an overall 3-5 hour bounded campaign, not a speed claim. Keep all process groups and logs watchable, one GPU fit at a time.
